card1994minimum.note: Author-hosted scan of the published AER article (26 pp., pp. 772-793). Text via pdftotext; Tables 3, 4 and 5 read from page images (PDF pp. 9 and 12 = journal pp. 780 and 783) because the table cells are missing from the text layer. Metadata (AER 84(4), 772-793, Sept 1994) confirmed on IDEAS/RePEc (ideas.repec.org/a/aea/aecrev/v84y1994i4p772-93.html), which lists no DOI; JSTOR SICI link given there.

card1993nber.note: NBER WP 4509, October 1993; metadata from Crossref. Working-paper version; its Table 3 reports the same DiD (2.76; balanced 2.75). Use the AER version for published numbers.

neumark1995payroll.note: NBER WP 5224, August 1995; metadata from Crossref and nber.org/papers/w5224. Scanned PDF; text layer is garbled, so all 38 pages were OCR'd with tesseract. Abstract and pp. 1-10 read; full text keyword-searched for trimming/outlier treatment. Numbers quoted in notes.md come from the abstract and pp. 1-3, 9.

neumark2000comment.note: Metadata only (Crossref + AEA article page + IDEAS). No abstract on AEA or IDEAS; full text paywalled (AEA PDF returned an HTML login page). Do not attribute findings or numbers to this entry; use neumark1995payroll for content.

card1998reanalysis.note: NBER WP 6386, January 1998 (same file as nber.org w6386.pdf, identical byte size). Scanned PDF, OCR'd with tesseract; abstract, introduction and Section I.A read. nber.org/papers/w6386 states the published version is the AER 2000 Reply (card2000reply). Card's website lists this PDF under the AER 2000 citation.

card2000reply.note: Metadata only (Crossref + AEA article page + IDEAS). Journal full text paywalled; AEA PDF request failed. Content claims go through card1998reanalysis, the working-paper version NBER links to this article.

conley2011inference.note: Journal metadata from Crossref (REStat 93(1):113-125, Feb 2011). Abstract read from the NBER Technical Working Paper 312 page (2005); journal page (direct.mit.edu) returned 403. Full text not read.

card_njmin_readme.note: Plain-text readme linked from davidcard.berkeley.edu/data_sets.html next to njmin.zip. Lists the five files in the archive. mamula2021replicating.note: Blog post dated 6/17/2021, read via WebFetch. An informal replication from the public njmin.zip data; evidence of prior replication, not a peer-reviewed source.

ropponen2010cic.note: MPRA 25181 (posted 13 Oct 2010) = HECER Discussion Paper 289 (April 2010). Full 18-page PDF read via pdftotext. Numbers in notes.md from pp. 4, 10-13 and footnotes 8, 16, 17.

ropponen2011reconciling.note: Metadata from Crossref. Abstract from IDEAS (which says it is borrowed from another version, VATT WP 24). Full text not read: Wiley paywalled; the VATT WP PDF on doria.fi and the JAE data archive (journaldata.zbw.eu) returned 403 / bot checks.

ropponen2014note.note: Metadata from Crossref and IDEAS; abstract from IDEAS (article page and VATT WP 25 page). Full text not read (Springer redirect to login; doria.fi 403).
